atAGlance: Gỏi gà is chicken salad, usually with cabbage, rau răm, onion, peanuts, and lime-fish sauce dressing.
whatItIs: Gỏi gà is shredded chicken salad with cabbage or banana blossom, rau răm, onion, peanuts, fried shallots, and fish-sauce-lime dressing.
howToEnjoy: Toss lightly so the shredded chicken picks up herbs and dressing without turning soggy. Peanuts and fried shallots should add crunch at the end.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi gà as a shared salad or light meal. Ask for no peanuts, less onion, or less chili before it is tossed.
worthKnowing: Rau răm gives many Vietnamese chicken salads their peppery, herbal lift; it is part of the identity, not a garnish.
goodToKnow: Chicken salad often uses fish sauce, rau răm, onion, and peanuts; the herb bite is part of the dish.
